verdict.rationale: Aider exposes a Python scripting API (Coder.create/coder.run, --message CLI flag) that lets AI-native users script basic edit instructions, but this covers only a subset of interactive chat capabilities — commands like /architect, /web, /voice, /test, /run, /map, /ask are documented only for the chat UI with no shown programmatic equivalent, and probes confirm no OpenAPI/REST surface exists (aider-probe-3). missing for 10: parity for special in-chat commands via the scripting API, a formal REST/OpenAPI interface, and evidence that the scripting API can trigger linting/testing/voice/browser features documented for interactive use.
